{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
sales = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Check how many refunded orders have converted = 1
refunded = sales[sales['status'] == 'refunded']
refunded_converted = refunded['converted'].sum()
refunded_count = len(refunded)

print(f"Number of refunded orders: {refunded_count}")
print(f"Number of refunded orders with converted = 1: {refunded_converted}")
print(f"Proportion of refunded orders with converted = 1: {refunded_converted / refunded_count:.3f}")

# Check if any non-refunded order has converted = 0
completed = sales[sales['status'] == 'completed']
completed_converted = completed['converted'].sum()
completed_count = len(completed)

print(f"Number of completed orders: {completed_count}")
print(f"Number of completed orders with converted = 1: {completed_converted}")
print(f"Proportion of completed orders with converted = 1: {completed_converted / completed_count:.3f}")

# Now compute conversion rate by segment
conversion_rate = sales.groupby('customer_segment')['converted'].mean()
print(f"Conversion rates by segment:\n{conversion_rate}")

# Find the segment with highest conversion rate
best_segment = conversion_rate.idxmax()
print(f"Best segment: {best_segment}")"}
